definition_of_ayu.english: Life is the combination of body (śarīra), sense organs (indriya), mind (sattva/manas), and soul (ātma). As long as these four are combined, life exists.

synonyms.dharī: That which prevents the body from decay
synonyms.nityagam: That which serves as permanent substratum of the body
synonyms.anubandham: That which transmigrates from one body to another

definition_of_ayurveda.english: The science or knowledge of life. Āyu = life; vetti = science or knowledge.

definition_of_health.english: Equilibrium state of the three doṣas (vāta, pitta, kapha) along with seven dhātus, three malas, and power of digestion, combined with pleasant mind, soul, and sense organs.

rakta_dosha_debate.AH_conclusion: Rakta cannot be called a doṣa — it is itself vitiated by the three doṣas, not vitiating others. The doṣas are three only.

prakriti_system.definition: Constitution of the body formed at the time of union of spermatozoa and ovum, based on dominant doṣa at that time.
prakriti_system.analogy: Like poisonous worms developing from poisonous material — the dominant doṣa at conception determines constitution.

dhatu_system.definition: Dhātus support the body throughout life. They get vitiated by the three doṣas and are called dūṣyas.

dhatus.function_english: Satisfaction to the mind and nourishing the body

dhatu_system.nourishment_principle: Each dhātu divides into 3 parts: (1) nourishes its own tissue, (2) nourishes the next succeeding dhātu as food, (3) becomes waste product.

vriddhi_kshaya_principle.vriddhi: Intake of food with similar qualities causes increase in corresponding dhātu/doṣa
vriddhi_kshaya_principle.kshaya: Intake of food with opposite qualities causes decrease

snehana_protocols.source: Ashtanga Hridayam Sutrasthana Ch. 16 — Sneha-Vidhi Adhyaya
snehana_protocols.definition: The process of producing unctuousness (snigdhata), fluidity, softness and smoothness in the body. Oleation is mandatory pre-operative procedure (purva karma) before all Panchakarma therapies.
snehana_protocols.role_in_panchakarma: Purva karma (pre-operative) — brings vitiated dosas from sakha (periphery) back to kostha (central GI) to enable elimination

best_oleating_substances.best_for: Joints, bones, vital organs, GI tract, burns, injuries, prolapsed uterus, ear and head diseases
Vata disorders, tumors, sinus, worms, kapha, medo roga, krura kostha

types_of_snehana.purpose: To mobilize dosas for elimination (purva karma for panchakarma)
Palliative oleation — mitigate dosas without eliminating

types_of_snehana.timing: Mixed with mutton soup, wine, or food
types_of_snehana.purpose: Body nourishment — for debilitated, elderly, children

eligible_persons: Habituated to wine, excessive coitus, heavy exercise
contraindications: Very weak OR very strong digestive power
Immediately after nasya, vasti, or virecana

purva_karma: Give mild carminative drugs (dipana) to stimulate digestion
Assess kostha type: mrdu = 3 days, madhyama = 5 days, krura = 7 days
Kostha pariksa: jaggery/sugarcane juice/milk/whey/rice pudding/ghee/grape juice — purgative = mrdu; no effect = krura
pradhana_karma: Administer medicated oil orally, 15–30 min after sunrise, empty stomach
Give hot water immediately after for digestion and mouth cleansing
Patient covers body with thick clothes, stays in breeze-free room
Warm water given at intervals when thirsty
paschat_karma: Use only warm water for drinking and bathing
Avoid rain, cold, sunlight, breeze exposure
Avoid loud talking and excessive eating
Use comfortable pillows (not too high or low)

signs_of_completed_digestion_jima: Disappearance of headache and above symptoms
snehana_protocols.confirmation_test: Give hot water — clear eructation = fully digested; oily eructation = still digesting
signs_of_improper_oleation: Exact opposite of proper oleation signs
complication_management: Khala, uddala, yava, syamaka, kodrava, pippali, triphala, ksoudra, pathya, gomutra, guggulu (as per dosa)

sadyosneha_yoga.description: Instant oleation recipes — ideal for children, aged, and non-compliant patients
recipes: Mutton soup (concentrated, more meat less water)
Peya (thin gruel) fried with oleating substances
Pahca prasrta peya: 1 prasrta (100ml) each of ghee, sesame oil, muscle fat, bone marrow + rice

procedure_after_snehapana.for_virecana: After snehapana → unctuous + liquid + hot mutton soup → sudation 3 days → administer purgative drug
procedure_after_snehapana.for_vamana: After snehapana → unctuous + liquid + hot mutton soup → sudation 1 day → kapha-stirring food (milk, fish, black gram) → administer emetic drug
procedure_after_snehapana.for_kapha_dominant: In muscular/fatty persons with kapha dominance — give drying drugs before snehapana for a few days to prevent complications

sirovasti.definition: Retention of large quantity of medicated oil on the head for a specific period using a cap made of animal skin or rexin cloth. Most potent of the four murdha taila methods.
pre_requisites: Prior purification with vamana and/or virecana
sirovasti.end_point_sign: Watery discharge from ears, mouth, and nose
post_care: Massage shoulders, neck, nape, forehead, face

diseases_from_vitiated_blood: Mukha, netra, siroroga (mouth, eye, head diseases)

collection_and_preservation: Collected in autumn season using gloves
Kept in earthenware or wide-mouthed bottle with clean water
Feed with lotus tubers/tubes, algae, dry fish, or mutton
Transfer to new container after 7 days
Change to fresh water + mud every 3 or 5 days to prevent blood intoxication
when_to_discard: Sluggish even after putting into water

procedure: Select non-poisonous leeches; keep in bottle with turmeric-water, sour gruel (avanti soma), or buttermilk
Transfer to pure water to make comfortable
Rub application site with dried cow dung cake powder
Apply leech to site
If leech does not attach: pour 1–2 drops of ghee, mud, breast milk, or blood; or give small incision
Once sucking: cover with soft cloth soaked in cold water
Remove when: pricking pain + itching at site (indicates leech now sucking pure blood)
Make leech vomit: apply salt and oil to mouth; press body downward after smearing with rice flour

vomiting_signs.proper: Leech moves freely in water; appetite increases
vomiting_signs.insufficient: Leech sluggish or not moving in water — make it vomit again

Apply gauze soaked in satadhouta ghrta (100-times washed ghee)
OR apply paste of: yastimadhu (Glycyrrhiza glabra), candana (Santalum album), usira (Vetiveria zizanoides)

contraindications: Immediately after snehapana or sodhana therapy
Mid-summer, winter, rainy season, overcast sky

Chest, forehead, outer angle of eyes

procedure: Patient undergoes oleation therapy first
Procure equipment, instruments, drugs, and antidotes
Perform spiritual rites; give unctuous food and mutton juice
Conduct mild sudation (sunlight or fire exposure)
Patient sits on knee-height stool, head capped
Massage neck briskly with cloth-padded fists; ask patient to grind teeth, cough, inflate mouth
Wind trunk with band of cloth
Tie cloth piece around neck; physician inserts index finger between cloth and krkatika marma
Tap vein with middle finger to engorge it
Give incision quickly and only once on bulged vein
Not too deep, not superficial; avoid vital points (marmas)

special_sites_procedure.jihwa (under tongue): Raise tongue between patient's own teeth; cut beneath
special_sites_procedure.griva (neck): Tie chest above breasts; patient holds stones in fists; massage abdomen upward to neck; give incision
special_sites_procedure.bahu (upper limbs): Close fists (thumb inside); stretch arms; tie 4 inches above site; give incision
special_sites_procedure.pada (feet): Massage from knee to ankle; tie 4 inches above site; give incision

signs_of_incision_quality.insufficient: Small quantity flows briefly → promote bleeding with oil + slaked lime
signs_of_incision_quality.excessive: Severe bleeding with sound; difficult to stop

siravedhana.sign_vitiated_blood_cleared: Vitiated blood exits and stops automatically (like yellowish latex of svarnaksiri) — do NOT force further flow

complications_management.fainting: Remove tourniquet immediately; fan patient; continue later. If faints again: stop for that day; resume day 2 or 3
complications_management.residual_blood: If not causing complications, leave it; do NOT exceed 768 ml maximum

siravedhana.diet_after_procedure: Light diet; not too hot and not too cold; must stimulate agni (digestive fire)

Medicated fumigation with guggulu, aguru, siddhartha (white mustard), hingu, sarjarasa, saindhava lavana, vaca, nimbapatra — all mixed with ghee
Introduce gauze pack into wound — drugs mixed with honey, ghee, sesamum oil
Cover surface with thick plaster of barley flour
Bandage wound with long clean cloth (clockwise or anti-clockwise); knot must NOT be over wound
wound_protection: Protect from insects and flies by oblations
If pain is severe: apply paste of yastimadhu mixed with ghee on wound
Sprinkle water with leaves and white mustard seeds around patient's bed
Fumigate room and bed twice daily

physical_care: Fan wound with bunch of animal tail hair or with usira grass

Keep patient engaged in listening to stories, company of friends, elders, brahmins

Conduct suturing

leaf_bandage_rules.for_kapha_or_usna_kala: Leaves with ruksa (dry) and usna (hot) guna

Patient experiences less pain during movement when wound is bandaged
All 5 wound types (uneven, hard, soft, painful, painless) clean and heal faster with bandaging

ksara_karma.definition: Therapeutic application of caustic alkalies derived from combination of drugs of all tastes (predominantly pungent and salt), which are penetrating and hot in potency.
additional_benefits: Performs functions of excision, incision, extraction, scarification
ksara_karma.superiority: Ksara is superior to all sharp instruments because it can be used where instruments fail (nasal polyps, malignant tumors, chronic multi-dosha ulcers) and can be administered internally.

grades_by_potency.indications: Arbuda (tumors) and disorders caused by Vata, Kapha, and Medas
Arbuda and diseases of moderate strength

Burn plant material + limestone; collect ashes
Add 4x water + 4x cow's urine to ashes; stir well
Filter through thick cloth until clear, red, thick liquid is obtained
Cook precipitate on oven using snehapaka method

During cooking add: macerated limestone powder, paste of cock/peacock/falcon/heron/pigeon excreta, bile juice of animals and birds, haritala, manahsila, saindhava lavana, red-hot conch shell (cooled before adding)
Store in heap of barley for preservation

nasal_polyps_nasa_roga: Alkali applied and left for 50 seconds

Cover with paste of ksira + mastu + kanjika (sweet, cold potency) mixed with ghee

management: Note: Sour substances are cold to touch and attain sweet taste by contact with alkaline substances — hence washing ksara wounds with sour substances is advised

Apply pastes of unctuous and cold substances

Patient sits on a knee-height seat in the evening hours
Leather strap (cow or buffalo hide): 12 angula wide, length = head circumference; wrap above ears; cover with cloth; tie with thread
Apply black gram flour paste inside and outside cap to prevent oil leakage
Pour lukewarm medicated oil into cap to a height of 1 angula above scalp
Replace oil with fresh warm oil whenever it cools
Continue until patient experiences watery discharge from ears, mouth, and nose (end point)
Collect used oil in a wide vessel (can be reused next day)
Remove cap; massage shoulders, neck, nape, forehead, and face
Give hot water bath; light food; follow oleation post-operative regimen
types_in_order_of_potency.matra_kala_definition: Time to blink eyes once OR time to move right hand around right knee joint once

general_benefits: Cures falling, graying, and matting of hair
Improves perception of all sense organs

procedure: Massage the base of the ear and surrounding area
Pour medicated ear drops into the ear canal
Retain until pain subsides OR up to 1,000 matra kala in healthy persons
karnapurana.matra_kala_definition: Time to blink eyes once OR time to move right hand around right knee joint once

ascotana.definition: Pouring medicated liquid into the eyes in a systematic way. First-line treatment for almost all eye disorders.

related_practice.name: Bidalaka
related_practice.definition: Applying paste of same drugs used for ascotana over the surface of eyelids (avoiding eyelashes)
related_practice.indication: Premonitory / prodromal stage of eye diseases

procedure: Ask patient to lie on bed in a room free of breeze
Gently massage closed eyelids
Take drug in a cowrie shell with a cotton wick
Instill drop by drop through the wick
Physician opens eyelids gently with left hand fingers
Instill from a height of approximately 2 inches
Dose: 10–12 drops over inner angle (medial canthus) of eye
Do NOT pour from more than 2-inch height (causes redness)

post_operative_care.general: Wipe surrounding area with clean cloth
post_operative_care.vata_kapha: Mild fomentation with cloth dipped in hot water

contraindications_for_drug: Drug that pools in one spot without spreading

indications: When dosas are localized in the eyes
Pakwa laksana signs: slight oedema, severe itching, sliminess
Slight friction, watery discharge, slight redness, thick excretions
Vitiation by pitta, kapha, rakta, and especially vata
cautions: When dosas are in increased state or not yet eliminated — do NOT apply anjana
In pitta and rakta diseases — conduct ascotana first, then apply anjana after dosa signs mitigate

types_by_therapeutic_purpose.name: Ropananjana
types_by_therapeutic_purpose.preparation: Unctuous substances processed with tikta (bitter) rasa drugs

types_by_therapeutic_purpose.name: Prasadananjana
types_by_therapeutic_purpose.preparation_rasa: Madhura (sweet) with sita (cold) virya + unctuous substances
indications: Vision loss from eclipse, intense sunrays, thunderbolt, lightning
Healthy persons — to maintain eye health
types_by_therapeutic_purpose.pratyanjana_note: Used as antidote after strong collyrium to manage complications; applied cold when burning occurs after strong collyrium

types_by_preparation_form.dose: One vidanga seed (moderate) / Two vidanga seeds (severe)
Two salaka (strong drugs) / Three salaka (mild drugs)

anjana.rod_measurements: 10 inches long, thin in middle, smooth, blunt ends resembling a flower bud

strong_collyrium_tiksna.preferred: Night (eyes rest and recover — cool, restful)
strong_collyrium_tiksna.unsuitable_even_at_night: Severe cold (dosas cannot be eliminated; causes itching and stagnation)

contraindications: During urge to pass urine or stools
After consuming alcohol or medicated fumes (dhumapana)
drug_contraindications: Too strong or too mild potency
Too little or too much quantity
Too thin or too thick consistency
procedure: Patient sits comfortably on a chair
Physician elevates upper eyelid with thumb
Take required dose on collyrium rod
Apply from inner angle (medial canthus) sweeping to outer angle of lower eyelid
Ask patient to close eyes and slowly rotate eyeball (up, down, right, left) for uniform distribution
Do NOT blink immediately after application
Do NOT apply pressure on eyelids
Do NOT wash eyes immediately

post_procedure_eye_washing.water_temperature: Cold in summer; warm in cold seasons
post_procedure_eye_washing.technique: Wipe left eye with right thumb; right eye with left thumb using clean cloth
post_procedure_eye_washing.why: Residual medicine stagnates and provokes dosas if not washed

signs_of_proper_anjana: No discomfort opening or closing eyelids
No sensitivity to sunlight and breeze

tarpana.definition: Keeping medicated ghee on the eyeballs for a specific duration using a wall constructed around the orbit.
prerequisites: Only after subsiding acute symptoms: redness, lachrymation, pus, pain
Purify body and head first with vamana, virecana, vasti, nasya
Conduct during normal seasons when sun shines and sky is clear
Perform in early morning or evening when temperature is less
indications: Tired eyes, unable to see objects properly
procedure: Construct a circular wall (2 inches high) around orbit rim with barley or black gram flour paste — must be leak-proof
Pour lukewarm medicated ghee (heated indirectly by steam) into the well while patient keeps eyes closed
Level: up to the submerging of eyelashes
Instruct patient to slowly open and close eyes
Note: Use muscle fat (mamsa vasa) instead of ghee in night blindness, cataract, and ptosis
post_procedure: Remove ghee by making small hole on lateral side
Remove flour paste wall; clean with fresh cloth
Conduct vairecanika dhumapana (purgative fumigation) to mitigate kapha
Wash face with lukewarm water; give wholesome diet
Rest in a place free from breeze

course_duration.vata: Daily for 1, 3, or 5 days, or till relief

tarpana.signs_of_excessive: Increase of kapha and kapha-type disorders

putapaka.definition: Conducted after tarpana to restore strength to the eyes, just as rest is needed after oleation therapy. Always performed after proper signs of tarpana are achieved.

types.name: Snehana Putapaka
materials: Flesh of prasaha animals (cow, ass, camel)
Jivaniya gana drugs pounded with milk
types.also_indicated_for: Dryness of eyes due to vata vitiation

types.name: Lekhana Putapaka
materials: Flesh and liver of desert-dwelling animals and birds

types.name: Prasadana Putapaka
types.indication: Defective vision from vata, pitta, rakta; heals eye ulcers
materials: Liver of desert-dwelling animals and birds
Heart of desert-dwelling animals and birds

preparation_procedure: Take 1 bilwa (~48g) of appropriate animal meat
Add equal quantity of appropriate drugs; grind into paste
Wrap in specified leaves (eranda/vata/ambhoja per type)
Tie with thick thread; coat in 2-inch mud layer; dry
Place in fire of burning coal (dhava, dhanvana wood) + dried animal excreta until red hot
Remove from fire; allow to auto-cool
Remove outer coating and leaves; squeeze contents through clean cloth
Collect juice; use in the evening hours similar to tarpana procedure
post_putapaka_care: Signs of proper/insufficient/excessive: same as tarpana
Parihara kala (post-treatment restriction) = double the number of treatment days
During nights: bandage eyes with flowers of malati and mallika (jasmine varieties)

contradiction_flags.veda_ai_action: MUST represent as conditional logic, NOT binary. Contraindications are relative, not absolute in all cases.
